title: BUILT, NOT CHASED
author: Eric Degenfelder
desc:
Built, Not Chased is a 16-week, block-periodized powerbuilding program for intermediate and advanced lifters. Five lifting days and two Zone 2 sessions a week, built around the squat, bench, and rack pull, with bodybuilding work for every muscle group.

Three phases (accumulation, intensification, realization) and two deloads lead to a Week 16 test: near-max singles with an optional PR attempt, a repeat-load row test, and body measurements against Week 1. Loads run off training maxes adjusted at set checkpoints, not on feel.

Train with purpose. Build strength. Let the numbers follow.
